module: Cryptographic Extension for BREW® Cryptographic Engine
description: QUALCOMMs Binary Runtime Environment for Wireless (BREW®) provides an integrated platform for developing, selling, and distributing wireless applications. The Cryptographic Extension for BREW® is a general-purpose, software-based cryptographic module packaged as a BREW® extension that can be invoked by BREW® applications to permit FIPS 140-2 Level 1 validated general-purpose cryptography.
tested_configurations: LG Firmware OS T98VZV05 with BREW 3.1 (single-user mode)

other_fields.Other Algorithms: DES-X; Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength); ECMQV (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength); ARC4; MD2; MD5; HMAC-MD5; DES; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength; non-compliant less than 112 bits of encryption strength)
